title: DAT Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for DAT operators, covering DAT modules, table dimensions, text and CSV access, save/write helpers, table resizing and mutation, row/column/cell lookup, and inherited OP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to treat a DAT as text, table data, or an importable Python module.
Use module to call functions defined in a DAT directly, and reserve text/csv for content-level edits or exports.
Use numRows and numCols for table-shape validation before indexed cell access.
Use setSize() for exact table dimensions, appendRow()/appendCol() for growth, and clear() when preserving or removing first rows and columns matters.
Use cell()/findCell()/cells() for table lookup instead of ad hoc string parsing of DAT text.
